author: (Goode & Bean, 1885)

note.en: A 33 cm flounder of soft bottoms at 20 to 230 m, sold fresh elsewhere, known here only from Bussing & López's guide and trawl specimens off Caribbean Panama.
note.es: Un lenguado de 33 cm de fondos blandos entre 20 y 230 m, que en otros lugares se vende fresco, conocido aquí solo por la guía de Bussing y López y por ejemplares de arrastre frente al Caribe de Panamá.

evidence: Added: not in the original species list
Listed for Costa Rica's Caribbean coast by Bussing & López (2010), whose guide is based on University of Costa Rica museum specimens
Trawl specimens off Caribbean Panama, including one at 95 m (Smithsonian, 1965)

sources.t: Bussing & López 2010, Peces costeros del Caribe de Centroamérica meridional, Rev. Biol. Trop. 58 (Suppl. 2): 190-193 (Paralichthyidae)
